## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change stays focused on one concern and targets `main`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check` successfully, or explained any failures or unavailable checks above.
- [ ] I added regression coverage for changed parsing, validation, search, comparison state, or refresh behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] I checked interface changes in Firefox, including keyboard focus and narrow layouts, where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed commands, deployment, storage, or user behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] I reviewed generated catalog changes and kept build output, local environment values, and logs out of the diff.
